title: Best Habit Tracker app so far
body:
Tried many apps, but decided to stick with this one because of its simplicity and clean UI. No subscription, no guilt, and it’s super easy to back-log past entries.

The only thing I’m craving is more icons, the current selection feels a bit limited. I’d also love to see more analytics and charts. Users love charts!
author: Thỏ rabbitt
